findings.detail: Pass 1 and 2 rightly rejected the 'Gemini-as-execution-agent' fiction, but did not make explicit that DriveTakeoutInventory is purely a JS Runner -> Apps Script execution procedure. PromptGemini governs this supervisory review dialogue, whereas the runtime execution of DriveTakeoutInventory does not call the Gemini API.

The original candidate relied on a rigid `sourceBytes > maxUnzipBytes` branch. In Apps Script, `Utilities.unzip(file.getBlob())` throws an untrapped runtime exception when archives exceed internal memory limits or contain unsupported formats, crashing before report generation. Decompression must be wrapped in a `try...catch` block to guarantee inspection report persistence regardless of decompression feasibility.

Under MetaProcedure properties P11 (State explicitness) and P12 (Transition semantics), the procedure lacked explicit state variables tracking remote execution, report file creation, local persistence, and deterministic error/retry branches.
